sloka: तं दृष्ट्वा कैकसी तत्र ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा ।आगम्य राक्षसी तत्र दशग्रीवमुवाच ह ।। ७.९.४१ ॥
transliteration: taṁ dṛṣṭvā kaikasī tatra jvalantamiva tejasā ।āgamya rākṣasī tatra daśagrīvamuvāca ha ।। 7.9.41 ॥

translations.english: Having seen him (Kubera) shining with splendor there, Kaikasi, the demoness, came to Dashagriva (Ravana) and indeed spoke to him.
